{{Quote|The selfishness is what astounds me. The Corellian sector is largely self-sufficient, wealthy, and with its own defense force. My sector hasn't even a third of these riches, yet we are committed to support the Republic in the most trying of times.|Senator Ister Paddie denounces Corellian succession during the Separatist Crisis|<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}}</ref>}}
'''Ister Paddie''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Sermeria]], who took [[Lanus Wrede]]'s place after he committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]]. Senator Paddie was a member of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] established prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I turn to some of the most trusted, skilled and intelligent minds that the Republic has to offer. This is the team that will help me forge a peaceful end to the current dispute.|Palpatine speaks of the newly created Loyalist committee, including Paddie.|<ref name="HNN49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}}</ref>}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Ister Paddie ascended from the noble [[Sermerian First House]] to represent his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sermeria]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|isterpaddie|Paddie, Ister}}</ref> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after the [[Death/Legends|suicide]] of his predecessor [[Lanus Wrede]], due to a false accusation Wrede made concerning [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]].<ref name="HN:46">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|business/1337_1.html|Baktoid Closes Down Five More Plants}}</ref> His first year as senator took place during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], in which succession from the Republic greatly increased and the the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] formed. During the crisis in 22 BBY, the senator of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], announced that his [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was closing its borders and removing itself from senate proceedings concerning the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], a proposal for the creation of a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Paddie was highly critical of the Corellians' decision due to their relative wealth compared to his own sector and the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] quoted the senators views on the matter in a piece concerning Corellia in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47]].<ref name="HN:47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}}</ref>

[[File:Loyalists_HNN.jpg|thumb|left|Paddie was a member of the Loyalist Committee.|250px]]
Later that same year, a package was found in the Sermerian First House in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Addolis]] on Sermeria, which caused the House to be partially evacuated for three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] due to fears the package might be dangerous. Addressed to both to Paddie and [[President/Legends|President]] [[Dibra Born]], the package contained a doll effigy of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] covered in [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]].<ref name="HN:48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_4.html|Suspicious Package Closes Sermerian First House}}</ref>
When Palpatine created a [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] from the Senate to negotiate with the Separatists and handle the situation, Paddie was named amongst the ten initial members. The group were tasked with creating a six [[Standard month/Legends|month]] action plan for handling the Separatists. They received large amounts of criticism from other senators who saw them as Palpatine's attempt to create a partisan body in an attempt to sway the Military Creation Act, although the members of the committee were strongly divided on the matter.<ref name="HN:49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}}</ref> Ultimately the Act was successful and a Grand Army of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] was formed, which the Republic used to combat the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] used by the Confederacy in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which began shortly after the Acts success.

==Personality and traits==
During his time as senator, Paddie was a loyalist who was particularly close to the office of Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="DB" /> Palpatine declared that he thought of the senator as one of the most trusted, skilled and intelligent members of the senate upon his addition to the Loyalist Committee.<ref name="HN:48" /> As befitting a noble of his status, he carried the regal airs of a noble and wore ornate, golden robes whilst in the senate and sported an orthodox hairstyle from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halbara/Legends|Halbara]].<ref name="AOTC:VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I think you may safely presume that given a choice between listening to the council of Mace Windu, or that of, say, the honorable Senator from Sermeria, with his startling ability to bring any topic under discussion to a close analysis of its impact on the trade in his homeworld's root vegetables, why, I would rather listen to you.|Palpatine possibly referencing Paddie in Yoda: Dark Rendezvous|<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
Ister Paddie was played by [[William Clay]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].

Paddie's ornate headdress is reminiscent of that worn by the [[Imperial Dignitary|Imperial Dignitaries]] introduced in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. This style also appears among concept sketches of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] citizens created for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].
